metadata.summary: The customer ordered a Poppyseed bagel with plain cream cheese, lightly toasted.

messages.text: Hello there, Welcome to Manhattan Bagel, I'm BagelBot an AI Assistant, and How can I assist you today?
I'd like to order one poppy seed bagel.
Got it! One Poppyseed bagel. Would you like to hear more options for your bagel or choose from these?
Yeah. I'd like to hear more.
Sure thing!
I'd like to hear.
Okay, here are some more bagel options: Garlic, French Toast Bagel, Multigrain Bagel, Onion, and Rye. Would you like one of these, or should I share more options?
No. I'll just take a poppy seed bagel.
Perfect! Poppyseed bagel it is. Now, would you like to hear more options for your spread or choose from these?
Yeah. I'll hear some options for the spread.
For your spread, you can choose from Butter, Plain Cream Cheese, Low-Fat Plain Cream Cheese, Grape Jelly, or Strawberry Jelly. Would you like one of these, or should I list more options?
Plain cream cheese. Plain cream cheese.
Perfect! Plain cream cheese it is. Now, would you like to hear more options for your toast level or choose from these?
For your toast level, you can choose Toasted, Lightly Toasted, Toasted Dark, or No Toast. Which would you prefer?
Lightly toasted.
Perfect! Lightly toasted. Now, would you like to hear more options for your add-ons or choose from these?
No.
Got it! Your Poppyseed bagel with plain cream cheese, lightly toasted. Is there anything else I can get for you today?
Nope.
Okay, so I have your Poppyseed bagel with plain cream cheese, lightly toasted. Let me get that all put together for you.
I hope you are still with me!
Yeah. I'm here.
Great! Let me just confirm your order one more time. You've ordered a Poppyseed bagel with plain cream cheese, lightly toasted. Is that all for you today?
Got it! Your order is all set. Your Poppyseed bagel with plain cream cheese, lightly toasted, will be ready for pickup in about 15 minutes. See you soon!
Thank you.
You're welcome! See you at Manhattan
